Execution 25%
Quality 30%
Communication 20%
Compliance Safety 15%
Reliability 10%
OxxO Revisits list. Query all tasks with the "CSAT (Customer Satisfaction) 1–5 rating" field set. Collect: name, status, CSAT rating, Store Name, Install Date, Vendor.
White Glove Sign Off Sheet list (list ID 7013245230104641712). Query all tasks with CSAT field set (include closed tasks). Collect: name, status, CSAT rating, Store Name, Project, Install Date, Vendor.

Southeast Ace - Elgin list and any other project lists with the CSAT field populated. Search broadly for tasks with CSAT data.

Parse the label text to extract the numeric score (e.g. label "5" or "5 – Very Satisfied" → score 5, label "4 – Satisfied" → score 4)
If the label contains non-numeric text, attempt to extract any digit 1-5 from it
Skip entries where no valid 1-5 score can be parsed from the label
Never assume a null or unparseable label equals zero; exclude it from averages entirely
Log a note in the dashboard footer if any CSAT entries were skipped due to parsing issues
Internally Sponsored Implementation
Projects with the "Internally Sponsored Implementation" field set (checked/true) are funded internally and not part of the services budget. These projects:
Are excluded from budget KPI totals (total invoiced YTD, pending invoices, avg cost per project, total revenue generation, cost of paid services)
Are excluded from the invoice aging buckets
Still appear in the Costs & Invoicing tables and charts, clearly marked with an "Internal" badge and visually distinguished (lighter row background) so they're visible but obviously separate from budget spend
Still appear in the Projects table, Pipeline, Overview active counts, Timeline, and everywhere else on the dashboard
Display a small "Internal" badge wherever they appear to distinguish them visually
The Costs section should show a secondary line below the budget KPI cards: "X projects ($YYY) internally sponsored, not in budget" for quick context
KPI Calculations
From the collected data, compute:
Header / Financial Summary (top of dashboard)
Total Revenue Generation: sum of all Customer invoice values (all projects, including internal)
Total Cost of Services: sum of all Vendor invoice values (all projects, including internal)
Cost of Paid Services: sum of Vendor invoice values for non-internally-sponsored projects only. This confirms spend on services the customer actually paid for.
Operational KPIs
Total active projects (exclude completed and cancelled, 2026 only)
In Progress + Scheduled count
Total ESLs in pipeline (sum # of ESLs across active projects)
Total stores in pipeline (sum # of Stores across active projects)
Completion rate (completed / total non-cancelled, as percentage)
Average vendor score (mean of all vendors' Avg Final Score %)
Total invoiced YTD (sum of all Vendor invoice values, excluding Internally Sponsored)
Pending invoices (sum of Vendor invoice where status = pending vendor invoice, excluding Internally Sponsored)
Average cost per project (total invoiced / count of invoiced projects, excluding Internally Sponsored)
Overall average CSAT (mean of all CSAT responses, numeric 1-5)
CSAT by vendor (group CSAT responses by vendor)
Low CSAT count (responses scoring 3 or below)
Invoice Aging Buckets
For all tasks with status = "pending vendor invoice" (excluding Internally Sponsored), calculate aging from the task's date of last status change (or date updated if unavailable) to today:
0-30 days: Current pending invoices
31-60 days: Aging invoices requiring follow-up
61-90 days: Overdue invoices needing escalation
90+ days: Critical overdue invoices

Display the count and dollar total for each bucket.
Project Risk Flags
Auto-flag projects as "at risk" when ANY of the following conditions are met:
Stale: No status update in 14+ days (compare date of last status change or date_updated to today)
Missing PO: Project has a Vendor invoice value but PO # field is empty/null (does not apply to Internally Sponsored projects)
Timeline Blown: End Date is in the past but status is not completed/cancelled

Each flag should be tagged with its reason(s). A project can have multiple risk flags.

Build a single self-contained HTML file using the DESIGN-UI skill. The dashboard must:
Structure
Sticky dark nav bar with the Vusion logo and "VUSION" wordmark on the left, followed by clickable section tabs (Overview, Pipeline, Projects, Costs, CSAT, Vendors, Scorecards, AP Installs, Timeline)
Vusion Logo (always include): Render as an inline SVG in the nav bar. The logo is a bold, slightly stylized golden-yellow "V" character centered inside a rounded square border. Use color #E8B630 (golden yellow) for both the V letterform and the square border stroke, with the nav's dark background showing through the interior. The square border should have rounded corners (~15% radius). Size the logo at approximately 32×32px. Immediately to the right of the logo, display "VUSION" as bold text in the same #E8B630 golden-yellow, with moderate letter-spacing (0.05em). This branding block is always present on the left edge of the nav bar, before any section tabs.
Each section has an anchor ID so tabs scroll to it smoothly
A floating back-to-top button appears after scrolling
Active nav tab highlights based on scroll position (IntersectionObserver)
All project names, store names, and task references must be clickable links that open the corresponding ClickUp task in a new tab using the task URLs from the query results
Sections
Overview: Start with a prominent financial header row showing: Total Revenue Generation, Total Cost of Services, Cost of Paid Services. Then below, operational KPI cards (total active, in progress/scheduled, ESLs, avg vendor score, avg CSAT). Add a small "⚠️ X at risk" badge on the active projects card linking to the risk flags in the Projects section.

Pipeline: Horizontal stacked bar showing task counts per status (color-coded). Doughnut chart of projects by service type. Bar chart of projects by vendor (completed vs active stacks).

Projects: Table of key active projects with columns: Project (clickable link to task), Status (color badge), Vendor, Stores, ESLs, Timeline, State, Risk (flag icons with tooltip showing reason). Include all projects that are not completed or cancelled. Sort by significance (in-progress first, then scheduled, then SOW sent, quote requested, prospective, on hold). Projects with risk flags should have a colored left border (amber for 1 flag, red for 2+) and display small icon badges:
🕐 = Stale (no update 14+ days)
📋 = Missing PO
⏰ = Timeline blown

Internally Sponsored projects display a small "Internal" pill badge next to their name.

Costs & Invoicing: KPI cards (total invoiced, pending invoices, avg cost/project, largest invoice) reflecting budget-only figures (excluding Internally Sponsored). Below the KPI cards, show a secondary summary line: "X projects ($YYY) internally sponsored, not in budget." Invoice Aging section: horizontal stacked bar showing the 4 aging buckets (0-30 green, 31-60 amber, 61-90 orange, 90+ red) with count and dollar total labels. Bar chart of spend by vendor. Doughnut of spend by service type. Table of top 10 invoiced projects by value with columns: Project (clickable), Vendor, Service, Customer Invoice, Vendor Invoice, PO #, Status. Internally Sponsored projects still appear in this table but with an "Internal" badge and a subtly different row style (lighter background). Below the table, list any invoices in the 61-90 or 90+ day buckets with direct task links for quick action.

CSAT: KPI cards (overall avg, avg by project group like OxxO Revisits vs White Glove vs Hucks, low score count). Bar chart of CSAT by vendor (include all vendors with CSAT data: Channel Partners, Impulso, Anderson, etc.). Distribution bar chart showing count of each score (1-5). Full table of all CSAT responses with columns: Store (clickable link to task), Project, Vendor, Date, CSAT score (color-coded badge). Sort worst scores first. If any CSAT entries were skipped due to label parsing issues, show a small info banner noting how many were excluded.

Vendors: Horizontal bar rows showing each vendor's total spend (budget-only, excluding Internally Sponsored). "At Risk" summary (pending invoices, on hold, cancelled counts).

Scorecards: One panel per scored vendor containing:
Vendor name and overall score (color-coded: green >85%, blue 70-85%, amber 50-70%, red <50%)
Radar chart (Chart.js) showing the 5 category scores on a 0-5 scale
Category bar breakdown with numeric values
Individual project scores listed below
A comparison horizontal bar chart across all vendors at the bottom

AP Installs: Table with Site (clickable), Status, Vendor, Type columns.

Timeline: Bar chart (Chart.js) showing scheduled installs per month and ESL volume on a secondary y-axis, covering the next 6 months from current date.
Visual Design
Font: DM Sans from Google Fonts
Color system: OKLCH-based with tinted neutrals toward hue 250
Status badges: color-coded pill with dot (in-progress=blue, scheduled=green, on-hold=amber, prospective=purple, accepted=teal, pending=red, quote=gray, sow=gold)
CSAT score badges: color-coded squares (5=green, 4=teal, 3=amber, 2=red, 1=dark red)
Risk flag badges: small rounded pills (stale=slate, missing-PO=amber, timeline-blown=red)
Internal badge: small outlined pill in neutral gray, text "Internal"
Invoice aging bars: gradient from green (current) through amber/orange to red (90+ days)
Charts: Chart.js (available as Chart). Use the library for doughnut, bar, and radar charts.
All CSS and JS inline. No external dependencies except the font and Chart.js.
Responsive: collapses to single column below 1024px
Light mode only
Data Presentation
Use real data from queries, never placeholder text
Format large numbers with commas (1,510,000 not 1510000)
Abbreviate to K/M for KPI cards when appropriate (1.51M, 324K)
Dollar amounts with $ prefix and commas
Dates as "Mon DD" or "Mon DD, YYYY" format
Include the current date and user name in the nav bar (right side)
Show "2026 Only" indicator in the nav bar
Show risk flag count in the nav bar as a small badge (e.g. "⚠️ 3")
Output
Deliver the HTML file via the DESIGN-UI artifact tool. After creating it, briefly summarize key metrics and any notable changes or flags (low CSAT scores, pending invoices, at-risk projects, aging invoices needing attention, stale projects).

Stale: No status update in 14+ days (compare date of last status change or date_updated to today)
Missing PO: Project has a Vendor invoice value but PO # field is empty/null (does not apply to Internally Sponsored projects)
Timeline Blown: End Date is in the past but status is not completed/cancelled

Each flag should be tagged with its reason(s). A project can have multiple risk flags.
Dashboard Design
Build a single self-contained HTML file using the DESIGN-UI skill. The dashboard must:
Structure
Sticky dark nav bar with the Vusion logo and "VUSION" wordmark on the left, followed by clickable section tabs (Overview, Pipeline, Projects, Costs, CSAT, Vendors, Scorecards, AP Installs, Timeline)
Vusion Logo (always include): Render as an inline SVG in the nav bar. The logo is a bold, slightly stylized golden-yellow "V" character centered inside a rounded square border. Use color #E8B630 (golden yellow) for both the V letterform and the square border stroke, with the nav's dark background showing through the interior. The square border should have rounded corners (~15% radius). Size the logo at approximately 32×32px. Immediately to the right of the logo, display "VUSION" as bold text in the same #E8B630 golden-yellow, with moderate letter-spacing (0.05em). This branding block is always present on the left edge of the nav bar, before any section tabs.
Each section has an anchor ID so tabs scroll to it smoothly
A floating back-to-top button appears after scrolling
Active nav tab highlights based on scroll position (IntersectionObserver)
All project names, store names, and task references must be clickable links that open the corresponding ClickUp task in a new tab using the task URLs from the query results
Sections
Overview: Start with a prominent financial header row showing: Total Revenue Generation, Total Cost of Services, Cost of Paid Services. Then below, operational KPI cards (total active, in progress/scheduled, ESLs, avg vendor score, avg CSAT). Add a small "⚠️ X at risk" badge on the active projects card linking to the risk flags in the Projects section.

Pipeline: Horizontal stacked bar showing task counts per status (color-coded). Doughnut chart of projects by service type. Bar chart of projects by vendor (completed vs active stacks).

Projects: Table of key active projects with columns: Project (clickable link to task), Status (color badge), Vendor, Stores, ESLs, Timeline, State, Risk (flag icons with tooltip showing reason). Include all projects that are not completed or cancelled. Sort by significance (in-progress first, then scheduled, then SOW sent, quote requested, prospective, on hold). Projects with risk flags should have a colored left border (amber for 1 flag, red for 2+) and display small icon badges:
🕐 = Stale (no update 14+ days)
📋 = Missing PO
⏰ = Timeline blown

Internally Sponsored projects display a small "Internal" pill badge next to their name.

Costs & Invoicing: KPI cards (total invoiced, pending invoices, avg cost/project, largest invoice) reflecting budget-only figures (excluding Internally Sponsored). Below the KPI cards, show a secondary summary line: "X projects ($YYY) internally sponsored, not in budget." Invoice Aging section: horizontal stacked bar showing the 4 aging buckets (0-30 green, 31-60 amber, 61-90 orange, 90+ red) with count and dollar total labels. Bar chart of spend by vendor. Doughnut of spend by service type. Table of top 10 invoiced projects by value with columns: Project (clickable), Vendor, Service, Customer Invoice, Vendor Invoice, PO #, Status. Internally Sponsored projects still appear in this table but with an "Internal" badge and a subtly different row style (lighter background). Below the table, list any invoices in the 61-90 or 90+ day buckets with direct task links for quick action.

CSAT: KPI cards (overall avg, avg by project group like OxxO Revisits vs White Glove vs Hucks, low score count). Bar chart of CSAT by vendor (include all vendors with CSAT data: Channel Partners, Impulso, Anderson, etc.). Distribution bar chart showing count of each score (1-5). Full table of all CSAT responses with columns: Store (clickable link to task), Project, Vendor, Date, CSAT score (color-coded badge). Sort worst scores first. If any CSAT entries were skipped due to label parsing issues, show a small info banner noting how many were excluded.

Vendors: Horizontal bar rows showing each vendor's total spend (budget-only, excluding Internally Sponsored). "At Risk" summary (pending invoices, on hold, cancelled counts).

Scorecards: One panel per scored vendor containing:
Vendor name and overall score (color-coded: green >85%, blue 70-85%, amber 50-70%, red <50%)
Radar chart (Chart.js) showing the 5 category scores on a 0-5 scale
Category bar breakdown with numeric values
Individual project scores listed below
A comparison horizontal bar chart across all vendors at the bottom

AP Installs: Table with Site (clickable), Status, Vendor, Type columns.

Timeline: Bar chart (Chart.js) showing scheduled installs per month and ESL volume on a secondary y-axis, covering the next 6 months from current date.
Visual Design
Font: DM Sans from Google Fonts
Color system: OKLCH-based with tinted neutrals toward hue 250
Status badges: color-coded pill with dot (in-progress=blue, scheduled=green, on-hold=amber, prospective=purple, accepted=teal, pending=red, quote=gray, sow=gold)
CSAT score badges: color-coded squares (5=green, 4=teal, 3=amber, 2=red, 1=dark red)
Risk flag badges: small rounded pills (stale=slate, missing-PO=amber, timeline-blown=red)
Internal badge: small outlined pill in neutral gray, text "Internal"
Invoice aging bars: gradient from green (current) through amber/orange to red (90+ days)
Charts: Chart.js (available as Chart). Use the library for doughnut, bar, and radar charts.
All CSS and JS inline. No external dependencies except the font and Chart.js.
Responsive: collapses to single column below 1024px
Light mode only
Data Presentation
Use real data from queries, never placeholder text
Format large numbers with commas (1,510,000 not 1510000)
Abbreviate to K/M for KPI cards when appropriate (1.51M, 324K)
Dollar amounts with $ prefix and commas
Dates as "Mon DD" or "Mon DD, YYYY" format
Include the current date and user name in the nav bar (right side)
Show "2026 Only" indicator in the nav bar
Show risk flag count in the nav bar as a small badge (e.g. "⚠️ 3")

Deliver the HTML file via the DESIGN-UI artifact tool. After creating it, briefly summarize key metrics and any notable changes or flags (low CSAT scores, pending invoices, at-risk projects, aging invoices needing attention, stale projects).
